answer: Locks are published in quill, expire in knoll, and ivory lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 177 aliases therefore needs 118 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3753 identities would post 2359 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
